Colorize

The image intensifies and shifts in hue on hover/focus, producing a vivid colourised look.

Hover or focus the image to see the effect.

HTML

CSS

.hover-effect.colorize img{
  filter: hue-rotate(0deg) saturate(1);
  transition: filter 0.5s ease;
}
.hover-effect.colorize:hover img,
.hover-effect.colorize:focus-visible img{
  filter: hue-rotate(30deg) saturate(3);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hover-effect.colorize img{
    transition: none;
  }
  .hover-effect.colorize:hover img,
  .hover-effect.colorize:focus-visible img{
    filter: hue-rotate(30deg) saturate(3);
  }
}

The animates a combined filter: hue-rotate() saturate() to give a colourised look. Select the code and copy with Ctrl+C or ⌘C.
